title: Protocol amendment 2: parallel schedule to meet the 17:00 UTC simulation deadline
body:
Requested by the user on 2026-11-01 ('speed up the study2 workflow, we need to get the simulation results before 12pm EST ... use more subagents in parallel'). Scientific criteria in A0001 are unchanged; only sequencing and time boxes change.

1. P2 fitting runs in parallel with the qualification benchmark (T0011) instead of after it. Guard: the P2 fit uses the model R3 froze in T0011 (work/T0011/model_frozen, sha256 logged before any P2 fit); no model change after P2 fitting starts; nothing from the P2 fit feeds back into the benchmark. P2 results count as qualified only if R5 passes the benchmark; otherwise they are reported as 'not qualified' and the intervention results are labelled exploratory.
2. R3 first commits a preliminary MAP-ensemble ModelBundle for P2 so R4 can start intervention simulations, then a final NUTS ModelBundle (not superseding); R4 reruns the final simulations on the final bundle. Predictions are frozen only on final bundles.
3. Time boxes: about 75-90 min wall clock per fit; compute split across the GCP VM (32 vCPU) and the local machine (22 cores).
4. budgets.max_parallel_agents raised from 4 to 6.
5. R5 may reuse its study-001 diagnostic code (studies/study-001/work/T0031 scripts only; no study-001 results or logs).
